about.lead: I'm a graphic designer. I make music packaging and identity where tactility matters: type with character, textured photography, a careful grid.
about.body: I don't like slick templates. I like a cover that smells of ink and a sleeve you want to turn over in your hands. My tools: Adobe CC, Figma, Cinema 4D, and a bit of code for the web.

exp.sub: 7 years in design: the concert industry, e-commerce and print.
exp.r1about: Concert agency, touring campaigns for popular artists.
exp.r1n1: Concert posters and online-ad materials (Egor Kreed, Zveri, Basta, Artik & Asti, Xolidayboy, Alisa, Evgeny Chebatkov)
exp.r1n2: Outdoor advertising for print (6×3 billboards, city formats, pillars), TV spots and animation for digital screens
exp.r1n3: 100+ events a year; a homegrown system for quickly updating layouts
exp.r2about: Ready-made websites, online stores and a cloud CRM platform.
exp.r2n1: Design of websites, landing pages and product materials; work with the design system
exp.r2n2: Ad and social creatives, resizes, retouching and photo editing, basic animation
exp.r2n3: AI tools for concepts and refining visuals (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Nano Banana)
exp.r3n1: Posters for mass events (concerts, theatre, stand-up, kids' shows) and online-ad materials
exp.r3n2: Outdoor advertising, TV spots, animation for digital screens, brand-book presentations
exp.r3n3: Also — backstage manager on tours (Zveri, Basta, Anna Asti, Egor Kreed, Lolita, Shaman)

nebo.sub: An advertising campaign for Nebo Records tours — a system of posters and adaptations for cities, venues and formats. Over a hundred concerts a year, one visual language.
nebo.s1p: I get photos of the artist, logos, fonts, and sometimes a ready key layout from the artist's team.
nebo.s2p: I build or adapt the master layout into a single system. I make digital and print poster versions in several aspect ratios for approval.
nebo.s3p: I prepare resizes for every required platform. Digital first, then print formats. What's left is to repeat this step for all the tour dates.
nebo.s4p: I make new formats during the promo campaign. Usually these are print surfaces; sometimes animated digital screens and TV ads come in.

cloud.sub: A series of blog covers for the SaaS product Aspro.Cloud. One visual language at scale: 3D renders, clean typography and a recognizable blue-lavender palette.
cloud.c1p: All covers are 16:9 on one grid: a place for the headline, an area for the main object, the product caption.
cloud.c2p: Volumetric glass and metal renders on a clean gradient — this keeps the series recognizable.
cloud.c3p: A large, dense headline on the grid: the article topic reads even in a small feed preview.
cloud.c4p: A blue-lavender gradient with a pink accent — the product's brand colors, shared across the whole series.
cloud.c5p: Promo and light topics are light; analytics and summaries are dark. The tone follows the article's meaning.
cloud.c6p: Templates and render presets let me assemble a new cover for an article fast, without losing the style.
